title: Insert, update, delete

checks.name: author 7 is Nina Park from Korea
checks.query: SELECT name, country FROM authors WHERE id = 7

checks.name: book 13 is Tidal by author 7
checks.query: SELECT title, author_id, year, price, genre FROM books WHERE id = 13

checks.name: science books cost 10% more
checks.query: SELECT id, ROUND(price, 2) FROM books WHERE genre = 'science' ORDER BY id

checks.name: other books keep their price
checks.query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price), 2) FROM books WHERE genre <> 'science' AND id <= 12

hints: Four statements, each ending with a semicolon: two INSERTs, one UPDATE, one DELETE.
